title: A Thorn for the Oath
author: Bram Zhou
blurb: Lena Kavanagh, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent ten years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
